title: cargo-modfmt Configuration Schema
description: Schema for modfmt.toml. All settings are optional; omitted settings use their defaults.

files.description: File selection settings for check, write, and files.

respect_gitignore.description: Respect .gitignore during directory traversal. Explicit files bypass this filter. Hidden paths and target directories are always skipped during traversal.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style exclusion patterns, relative to the configuration file's directory (or the working directory without a configuration file). Applies to explicit files as well as directory traversal. CLI --exclude patterns are added to this list.

items.description: A single-line gitignore-style pattern. Re-inclusion with a leading unescaped ! is not supported. Glob syntax is validated by the application.

format.description: Source parsing and import sorting settings.

edition.description: Rust parsing edition. CLI --edition overrides this setting. If omitted, use the source package edition, then rustfmt edition, then 2024.

style_edition.description: Rust style edition used to sort imports. CLI --style-edition overrides this setting. If omitted, use rustfmt style_edition, then the resolved parsing edition.
